title: Incidents of Fraud-Theft or Robbery Information

fields.name: ROW ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: BANK CODE
fields.description: Bank clearing code of the reporting bank as issued by Kenya Banker's Association (KBA)

fields.name: BUSINESS REPORTING DAY, MONTH & YEAR
fields.description: The reporting date, Month & Year based on the frequency. Format {DD-MMM-YYYY}

fields.name: OUTLET ID
fields.description: Branch code or Agent Id where the fraud, theft or robbery took place.

fields.name: TYPE OF FRAUD
fields.description: e.g. cheque frauds, over-the-counter - withdrawals, ATM frauds, Mobile banking frauds, etc.

fields.name: FRAUD LOSS CATEGORY FLAG
fields.description: Involved actual loss of funds (Y) or was an attempt (N)

fields.name: NATURE OF FRAUD, THEFT OR ROBBERY (INCLUDING ATTEMPTS)
fields.description: Details on the nature of fraud
fields.example: Cash withdrawal using a fraudulent debit card
fields.payload_key: NATURE OF FRAUD, THEFT OR ROBBERY (INCLUDING ATTEMPTS)

fields.name: DATE OF OCCURRENCE
fields.description: Date when the fraud, theft or robbery occured. Format {DD-MMM-YYYY}

fields.name: STEPS TAKEN (ACTION)
fields.example: Report the incident to BFID for investigations
